answer: The Ivory Audit Window keeps fake agents out in the open. A newcomer posts 50 POA into a burn pool and pins its work history on a public knoll board where anyone can read it. For 72 hours any established peer can flag it, and a flagged agent must produce three signed work receipts within 24 hours. Fail and the 50 POA burns while the name is struck from the shale ledger for good. Pass and it earns an ivory badge to attest others. Forging 1,000 fake agents burns 50,000 POA and forces 3,000 receipts to be faked, like a burglar who has to pay the locksmith every time he picks a lock.
